keyPoints.en: Start with customer needs (surveys, interviews) and a project brief: what, for whom, why.
keyPoints.bm: Mulakan dengan keperluan pelanggan (tinjauan, temu bual) dan taklimat projek: apa, untuk siapa, mengapa.

keyPoints.en: Identify the technology base — mechanisms, electronics, materials.
keyPoints.bm: Kenal pasti asas teknologi — mekanisme, elektronik, bahan.

keyPoints.en: Concept and product sketches using design elements and principles.
keyPoints.bm: Lakaran konsep dan produk menggunakan elemen dan prinsip reka bentuk.

keyPoints.en: Work schedule (Gantt chart); list of materials, tools and budget — balance = budget − total cost.
keyPoints.bm: Jadual kerja (carta Gantt); senarai bahan, peralatan dan bajet — baki = bajet − jumlah kos.

keyPoints.en: Make a functional or partly functional product; test function and suitability.
keyPoints.bm: Hasilkan produk berfungsi atau berfungsi sebahagian; uji fungsi dan kesesuaian.

keyPoints.en: Propose improvements from test results and document the whole process.
keyPoints.bm: Cadangkan penambahbaikan berdasarkan keputusan ujian dan dokumentasikan keseluruhan proses.
